#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <regex>

int main() {
    std::string s;
    std::cin >> s;
    std::regex pattern(R"((.)\1*)");
    std::smatch match;
    int insertions = 0;
    std::string::const_iterator searchStart(s.cbegin());
    while (std::regex_search(searchStart, s.cend(), match, pattern)) {
        if (match.str().length() % 2 == 0) {
            insertions++;
        }
        searchStart = match.suffix().first;
    }
    std::cout << insertions << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
